description:
<MyComp prop={x}/> in ~F templates compiles to {:component, MyComp, props, nil} vnode tuples instead of calling Filament.TagEngine.component/3. Substrate walker (Phase 1.1) already handles {:component, ...} fiber registration, so this ticket is purely about codegen.

## Files
- lib/filament/vnode_engine.ex
- lib/filament/tag_engine.ex (component/local_component/remote_component handle_token branches)

## Acceptance
- Parent template <Child prop={v}/> emits a {:component, Child, %{prop: v}, nil} vnode at runtime.
- Walker registers child fiber correctly (round-trip test through Reconciler.mount).
- Filament.TagEngine.component/3 and component_keyed/4 still callable for the legacy path until 1.4.7.
title: Phase 1.4.2: Component tags emit :component vnodes
